free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: Up to 1 TB per file on every plan, including Free; there is no per-file fee, only the total storage quota.

retention.stated: Anonymous downloads expire 7 hours after link generation; temp files auto-delete at 7 days.
retention.notes: Toggle Temporary before you upload and the file is automatically deleted 7 days later; it does not count against permanent storage.

egress.terms: All plans include unlimited file size, unlimited bandwidth, and every platform feature.

tooling: Supports rclone via WebDAV (`https://patrins.com/dav`). Features REST API and tus 1.0 resumable uploads, webhooks, command-line interface, Telegram integration, and WebDAV drive mapping.
chaining: 8 GB permanent storage with 1 TB max file size; rclone mount patrins: /mnt/patrins.
limits_note: Free 8 GB storage, unlimited file size, unlimited bandwidth. Rate limits: public upload init 500/hour (files <1 GB) and 30/hour (>=1 GB) per IP; chunks 500/hour; finalize 30/hour; bulk zip 10/hour per user. Anonymous downloads expire 7 hours after link generation; temp files auto-delete at 7 days.

reliability_note: Per-file cap without matching storage is the classic trap: 1 TB/file x 8 GB total means the big-file capability is unusable without paying. API init returns 401 'Authentication required' without a bearer token, so 'no account needed' only holds for the temp flow.

extras.quota_verbatim: Two separate numbers, and the split matters: free plan storage is 8 GB, but the per-file ceiling is unlimited (marketing says 1 TB) on every plan including free, with unlimited bandwidth. Anonymous temporary uploads accept up to 1 TB per file and self-delete after 7 days.
extras.limits_verbatim: Free 8 GB storage, unlimited file size, unlimited bandwidth. Rate limits: public upload init 500/hour (files <1 GB) and 30/hour (>=1 GB) per IP; chunks 500/hour; finalize 30/hour; bulk zip 10/hour per user. Anonymous downloads expire 7 hours after link generation; temp files auto-delete at 7 days.
extras.egress_verbatim: Unlimited bandwidth on all plans, stated on the pricing table and repeated in docs. No egress product.
extras.chaining_verbatim: rclone WebDAV mount + N free accounts x 8 GB permanent, or the anonymous 1 TB-per-file path for transit. The 8 GB cap is the binding number for storage; 1 TB/file only helps if something downstream holds the bytes.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Documented rclone: `rclone config create patrins webdav url=https://patrins.com/dav user=you@email.com pass=YOUR_DAV_TOKEN`. Also REST + tus 1.0 resumable upload, webhooks, CLI, a Telegram bot and a Windows `net use` drive mapping.
extras.agent_focus: regional and non-English large-file hosts, especially very large single-file caps with no total-storage limit

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
